autofish.configuration.autofishEnabled.t: Toggles the entire mod on or off.
autofish.configuration.multiRod.tooltip: Cycles through all available rods in the hotbar, moving to the next as they break.
autofish.configuration.openWaterDetectEn: In game versions above 1.16, you can only get treasure loot at open water. This will alert you when you are not fishing at open water.
autofish.configuration.noBreak.tooltip: Stop using rods with low durability before they break.
autofish.configuration.persistentMode.to: Always keep the fish hook cast whenever a rod is in hand. Checks every 10 seconds and recasts if needed.
autofish.configuration.autoTurnView.tool: Automatically turn the camera view when a fish is caught.
autofish.configuration.turnAngle.tooltip: The angle in degrees to turn the camera when a fish is caught.
autofish.configuration.turnDuration.tool: How long to hold the turned view before restoring to original position (ms).
autofish.configuration.useSoundDetection: Newer, more accurate detection based on bobber sounds rather than standard hook movement detection. You must be somewhat close to the hook. If other players' hooks are near yours, it can falsely trigger a catch! Note: this option only affects multiplayer. Singleplayer uses its own detection.
Forces the use of multiplayer detection while in singleplayer. This provides compatibility with third party mods.
autofish.configuration.recastDelay.toolt: Adjusts the delay between catching a fish and recasting the rod. Range: 500–5000 ms.
autofish.configuration.randomPercent.too: Add +/-% randomness to the Recast Delay. Example: 20% makes a 1500ms delay fall in 1200–1800ms. Set to 0 to disable.
autofish.configuration.reelInDelay.toolt: Add a delay for the reel-in when a fish bites the float. Set to 1 to disable this function.
autofish.configuration.clearLagRegex.too: Recast the fishing rod when this regular expression pattern is matched in chat.
